newsitem.title: USA: Photronics's Michael Yomazzo adds CEO job.
newsitem.headline: Photronics's Michael Yomazzo adds CEO job.

text.p: Photronics Inc said on Tuesday that Michael Yomazzo, president and chief operating officer, has been elected chief executive officer.
Yomazzo succeeds Constantine Macricostas, the company's founder who will remain chairman, Photronics said in a statement.
In a separate statement containing the company's third quarter results, Photronics said it would not exercise its option to buy a controlling interest in P.K. Ltd in South Korea.

"After careful consideration and analysis, we determined that it was in the company's best interest to retain its minority equity investment position rather than to assume a controlling interest in P.K. Ltd at this time," Photronics said in a statement.
